original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚埃多州警方调查艺人MC Porcupine遇袭事件
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚埃多州警察局已对娱乐艺人Osagie Idieda（艺名MC Porcupine）在贝宁城遭暴徒袭击一事展开全面调查。警方发言人表示，事件发生在Idieda从贝宁城一场聚会返回途中。州警察局长已下令彻查事件经过、查明涉案人员并确保将责任人绳之以法。该袭击目前仍为据称状态，信息来自单一来源。

key_facts.fact: 埃多州警察局已对艺人MC Porcupine遭暴徒袭击一事展开全面调查
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Edo State Police Command has launched a full-scale investigation into an alleged attack on an entertainer, Osagie Idieda, popularly known as MC Porcupine, by hoodlums in Benin City.

key_facts.fact: 事件发生在Idieda从贝宁城一场聚会返回途中
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: confirming that the incident occurred while Idieda was returning from a party in Benin City

key_facts.fact: 州警察局长Patrick Daaor已下令立即彻查事件经过并追究责任人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Commissioner of Police, Edo State Command, CP Patrick Daaor, has ordered an immediate and thorough investigation to unravel the circumstances surrounding the incident

uncertainties: 袭击事件目前为据称（alleged），尚未获独立证实
事件具体经过与涉案人员尚待调查确认
目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，缺乏交叉验证
